definition.title: Tasks + Tickets merge smoke test ({{run}})
definition.body_md: Phil's live check of the Tasks + Tickets merge and the dates list (claude/tasks-merge-spec.md, MYC-163, migration 0139). The API path was smoke-tested from the PC; this ticket is the human half: one surface, the sticky Area chip, the sprint chip rule, the dates table, Started set once, Closed and Cancelled shown. Tick as you go; type what you saw in the answer boxes; anything that fails stays unticked with a comment naming the step id.

values.label: A project with an active sprint (or the one you will start one in)
A ticket key you can move around freely

intro.verdict_html: Five phases, about 20 minutes. Phase 1 is the one surface: navigation, the redirect, the label. Phase 2 is the Area chip and the sprint chip. Phase 3 is the dates table: sort and each filter. Phase 4 is Started: set on the first In Progress, unchanged after bouncing back. Phase 5 is Closed and Cancelled in the table. Nothing here needs Telegram.
prerequisites: {{project}} has an active sprint, or start one on /organisation/tickets/sprints first
{{ticket}} is open and not in a sprint you care about; it will be moved around and put back

phases.title: One surface
phases.lede_html: Tasks and Tickets are one page now, labelled Tasks. The old Tickets URL redirects.

steps.title: Open the Organisation section. The sidebar (or the tab bar on the phone) has ONE entry, "Tasks", and no "Tickets" entry
The Organisation index has one Tasks card and no Tickets card
Type /organisation/tickets in the address bar. You land on /organisation/tasks
Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and type {{ticket}}. The group is headed "Tasks" and the key opens the ticket page at /organisation/tickets/{{ticket}} (ticket pages keep their URLs)

phases.title: The Area chip and the sprint chip
phases.lede_html: Area is All · Technical · Life · a project. It sticks across reloads and devices because it lives in your settings, not the browser.

steps.title: On /organisation/tasks the Area row shows All selected. Pick Technical: the Inbox/Next/… counts and the list change to technical projects only

fields.label: Next count on All vs Technical

steps.title: Reload the page. Technical is still selected. Open the same page on the phone: Technical there too
Pick Life. Tickets with no project appear; nothing from a technical project does
On the Now tab with Area = All, Technical or Life there is NO ⚡ sprint chip. Pick {{project}} in the Project dropdown: the ⚡ sprint chip appears (the project has an active sprint)
Pick a project with no active sprint (or none). The ⚡ chip is gone again. Put Area back to All

phases.title: The dates table
phases.lede_html: Every ticket, done and cancelled included. Dates are London wall clock, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

steps.title: Open the Table tab. Columns: Key · Title · Project · Status · Raised · Started · Finished · Closed. Done and cancelled tickets are in the list
Click the Raised header: oldest first; click again: newest first; a third click clears the sort. Do the same on Started, Finished and Closed — empty dates sort last
Raised from = the first of this month, to = today. Only tickets raised this month remain. Clear it
Started from/to, then Finished from/to, then Closed from/to — each narrows to rows whose date is in the range, and a from-only or to-only bound works too. Clear each
Type part of {{ticket}} in Search: the row is found by key. Type a word from its title: found by title. Pick a Status: only that category. Change Area to Technical: the table narrows too

phases.title: Started: set once
phases.lede_html: Started is the first time a ticket enters In Progress. Leaving and coming back never changes it.

steps.title: Open {{ticket}}. If it has a Started date already, pick another open ticket that has never been In Progress and use that from here on. Note its Started in the Table: empty
Move it to In Progress. In the Table its Started now shows the current time (London)
Move it to Selected for Development, wait a minute, move it back to In Progress. Started is unchanged — the same value as 4.2

phases.title: Closed and Cancelled
phases.lede_html: Finished is Done's date; Closed is your verification; a cancelled ticket shows its date in Finished with a marker.

steps.title: Move the same ticket to Done, then press Close on its page. In the Table, Finished shows the Done time and Closed shows the Close time
Find any cancelled ticket in the Table (Status filter: Cancelled). Its Finished cell shows the cancelled time with a red Cancelled marker; Closed is empty
Put the ticket you used back where it was (reopen it if it was open). Verdict: anything you expected on the one surface that is not there?
